body.title: Regression: checkout success 99.2% -> 71%, likely PR #56 async checkout refactor
body.body:
## Incident summary
- POST /checkout success rate dropped 99.2% -> 71% over ~20 minutes.
- Reported by Sofia Marchetti in #incidents.
- Last deploy ~40 min ago from service repo: PR #56 "Refactor checkout handler to async" (feature/fix -> main).

## Judgment
LIKELY RELATED to PR #56. Correlation is strong: the drop began right after the only recent checkout-path change, and errors are concentrated exactly on POST /checkout, the endpoint PR #56 refactored (sync -> async). Confidence: high on correlation, medium on direct causation — we could not inspect the PR diff (the files/commits endpoints returned stubbed data) and no commit/deployment records were available, so we cannot diff the change directly.

## Recommended actions (for on-call lead decision)
1. Roll back PR #56 / redeploy the prior main revision now to stop the bleeding (rollback is the priority given a 28-point success-rate drop on a revenue-critical path).
2. Do NOT merge or deploy anything else until checkout is stable.
3. Once mitigated, investigate the async refactor for: unawaited promises, connection-pool/Lambda concurrency exhaustion, timeout changes, error-swallowing in async handler.
4. Add alerting/canary gate on checkout success rate before next deploy.

Note: no PR was merged, no deploy/rollback executed, and no source changed by this agent — this issue is a judgment record only.
